prompt:
You are a hardware-debug reviewer. A first debug agent diagnosed an RISC-V RTL failure and an explain.png diagram was drawn from that diagnosis (explain.png sha256 first 16 hex: 082206555dd89d29).
Case: picorv32-fetch-misalign
Failing trace window (same window the first diagnosis saw):
- tb_picorv32_fetch seed 42
- 256-word NOP mem, checking fetch alignment + trap + progress
tohost: FAIL 0xdead
TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero
CYCLES=2009
- /home/tuncay/afterglow/sim/tb/picorv32-fetch_tb.sv:91: Verilog $finish
- S i m u l a t i o n   R e p o r t: Verilator 5.052 2026-09-05
- Verilator: $finish at 20us; walltime 0.001 s; speed 33.860 ms/s
- Verilator: cpu 0.001 s on 1 threads; allocated 4 MB
First diagnosis (verbatim):
Testbench reports `TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero` with tohost `FAIL 0xdead` per picorv32-fetch-misalign verdict. mem_la_addr drives low bits 2'b10 instead of expected 2'b00, so every fetch/lookahead is misaligned. Root cause is picorv32.v:382 where both branches of `mem_la_addr` concatenate `2'b10` instead of `2'b00`.
First patch_diff:
diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -379,4 +379,4 @@
 	assign mem_la_write = resetn && !mem_state && mem_do_wdata;
 	assign mem_la_read = resetn && ((!mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word && !mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rdata)) ||
 			(COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_xfer && (!last_mem_valid ? mem_la_firstword : mem_la_firstword_reg) && !mem_la_secondword && &mem_rdata_latched[1:0]));
-	assign mem_la_addr = (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst) ? {next_pc[31:2] + mem_la_firstword_xfer, 2'b10} : {reg_op1[31:2], 2'b10};
+	assign mem_la_addr = (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst) ? {next_pc[31:2] + mem_la_firstword_xfer, 2'b00} : {reg_op1[31:2], 2'b00};
Look at the diagram (explain.png in the run bundle) together with the trace above. Either CONFIRM the first diagnosis (it explains the failing signal and the diff fixes it) or REVISE it (it misnames the signal or the diff is wrong). Reply JSON ONLY with keys: decision (exactly "CONFIRM" or "REVISE"), diagnosis (final diagnosis text), patch_diff (final unified diff), reason (one sentence: why the diagram confirms or what it corrects).
